A row that clears +EV purely on plus-money juice while the model essentially agrees with the fair number is a 1-star 'price-only edge — no model conviction' lean, never playable. (2) playable now requires REAL MODEL DIVERGENCE (|our_prob − market_devig_prob| >= 0.01) on top of +EV — micro-edges that only exist because of plus-money juice are 1-star 'price-only' leans.
